_note: English source for the landing page. Every other file in this folder has exactly these keys. Keys ending in _html may contain the {email} placeholder, nothing else. hero_bubble breaks onto its second line at \n. Brand names stay as they are: Grasp, App Store, iPhone, Android.
title: Grasp — your workout planned, your weights worked out
description: Grasp plans your workout and works out your weights from what you lifted last time. Free on Android and iPhone, no ads, works offline.
og_description: Plans your workout and works out your weights from last time. Free, no ads, works offline.
hero_lede: Tell me your goal and what equipment you've got, and I'll have today's workout ready. I remember what you lifted last time, so I know exactly what goes on the bar.
store_aria: Download Grasp on the App Store
hero_meta: Free on Android and iPhone, in 15 languages. No subscription, and I'll never ask you for a penny.
lang_lede: Not just the menus. Every screen, every exercise name and every step of how to do it, I explain in your language.
plan_title: Your next workout? Leave it to me
plan_body: Tell me your goal, how many days you train, how long you've got and what equipment you can actually reach. I'll never give you a move you can't do. Train in more than one place? Save a setup for each, and when you switch gyms I rebuild today's session.
plan_alt: Grasp's workout screen: eight exercises planned for a full-body muscle-building session, each with its weight
equip_title: Tick what you have and I'll work with that
equip_body: A few dumbbells at home, a full rack at the gym, a band in a hotel room. Save a setup for each place and switch in one tap, and I'll only plan exercises you can do with what's ticked.
equip_note_home: Home: 5 of 58 pieces ticked, so every exercise is one you can do there.
equip_note_gym: Gym: everything ticked, so the whole library is open.
equip_note_tail: Over 50 kinds of equipment to choose from.
routine_title: Got your own program? I'll follow it
routine_body1: Build a routine and set every set the way you like: warm-up, normal, drop set or to failure, exact reps or a range, and your own rest. I still fill in the weights from your last session, and you can change any number.
routine_body2: Pair exercises into supersets and drag them into order. Switch between my plan and your routines in one tap, and when a workout goes differently, you decide whether I update the routine with it.
routine_alt: A routine in Grasp: Barbell Bench Press set by set, a warm-up, two working sets and a drop set, then a superset of Cable Fly and Dumbbell Lateral Raise
prog_title: The stronger you get, the more I add
prog_body1: Hit the top of your rep range on every set and I put more on the bar next time. Don't agree? Change it in one tap, I won't be offended.
prog_ledger_why: Every set hit the top of your range, so I added 5 kg.
prog_body2: Miss it twice and I bring it back down. Five kilos here because that's the smallest step on the machine. I work out your warm-up sets too, and the rest timer starts on its own.
prog_alt: An exercise in Grasp: an animation of the movement, warm-up sets, and last time's weight
pr_title: Break a record and I'm the first to know
pr_body1: Heaviest weight, best estimated max, biggest set or more reps than ever. The moment you log the set, I put a trophy on it.
pr_body2: Your workout summary shows every record you set. I count them from the sets you logged, so if you fix a typo, the record gets fixed too.
pr_alt: New personal records in Grasp: 85 kg for 6 on the Barbell Bench Press and 12 reps on the Pull-Up, each marked with a trophy, and a summary of the four records
pr_banner_note: Heaviest weight: 85 kg, up from 82.5 kg
recap_title: Your month, as told by me
recap_body: On the 1st of every month I bring you last month in a few cards: the days you trained, the hours, the weight you lifted, your biggest jump and what you trained most, next to the month before. I've got something to say on every card, and at the end of the year I do the whole year.
share_title: Show off a little, you earned it
share_body: Finish a workout and share it as a card made for stories. Break a record and I'm on the card with you, holding the trophy. You can also send a routine to a friend as a link, and it opens straight in the app.
rec_body: I shade every muscle on a body map by how recently you worked it, so you see your whole week at a glance. The colour fades as the muscle recovers.
rec_alt: Grasp's body map, with the muscles trained today highlighted
vol_title: I count your sets for every muscle
vol_body: Every muscle group gets a weekly target, and you can change it. I show you where this week's work went and what's still waiting for you.
vol_alt: Grasp's weekly targets: sets done per muscle group against a target
int_title: Ropes, sprints, planks: I'll count the rounds
int_body: Work and rest, counted for you, with a sound at every change so you can put the phone down. Save your own presets. Between sets I ring when your rest is over, and you can watch it count down in your notifications.
int_alt: Grasp's interval timer with work, rest and round settings
log_title: Every session you've done, on the calendar
log_body: Everything lives on your phone and works with no signal. An account just keeps a backup, so a lost phone doesn't take your training with it. Export everything as a spreadsheet or a full backup whenever you like. It's your training, after all.
log_alt: Grasp's training log on a calendar
ai_title: I'm not an AI, I'm a gorilla who's good at maths
ai_p1: No AI decides what you lift. I use one simple rule you can check yourself: hit the top of your reps and I add weight, miss it twice and I take some off.
ai_p2: That's also why I work on your phone with no signal.
final_lede: Free on Android and iPhone. No ads, no subscription, nothing to unlock.
final_meta_html: Questions? Email {email}. Gyms and brands interested in working together, same address.
disclaimer: Grasp suggests training weights from what you log. It is not medical advice and it cannot see your form or your health. Talk to a doctor before starting a new training program, particularly if you have an injury or a health condition.
faq1_a: Yes. Grasp is completely free: no ads, no subscription, no paid tier and nothing to unlock.
faq2_a: Yes. Your workout and your weights are worked out on your phone, so it works in a gym with no signal. Only the first sign-up needs internet. The account is there to back up your training.
faq3_a: 15: English, Arabic, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Turkish, Polish, Russian, Hindi, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Indonesian and Portuguese. That includes the exercise names and the step-by-step instructions.
faq4_q: Can I train at home with just dumbbells?
faq4_a: Yes. Tick the equipment you have and Grasp only plans exercises you can do with it. Save a setup for home, the gym or a hotel and switch in one tap.
faq5_q: Can I make my own routines?
faq5_a: Yes. Build as many routines as you like, set by set: warm-ups, drop sets, sets to failure, exact reps or a range, and supersets. Grasp fills in the weights from your last session, and you can switch back to the Grasp plan any day.
faq6_q: How does Grasp pick my weights?
faq6_a: From what you logged last time. Reach the top of your rep range on every set and the weight goes up. Miss it twice and it comes down. You can change any weight in one tap.
faq7_a: No. It uses simple rules that run on your phone, which is why it works offline.
faq8_a: Yes. Grasp is free on Google Play for Android and on the App Store for iPhone.
faq9_a: Not for advertising. Grasp records which screens and features you use, never your weights or health data, to make the app better, and you can switch that off under Account. It does not use advertising identifiers, and it does not ask for your location, contacts or microphone. The camera only opens when you take a photo for a share card.
